title: Growth Experiment Loop
summary: A bounded build-measure-learn loop: hypothesis, experiment design, analysis, and a decision gate that either scales the winner, kills the line of inquiry, or iterates with what was learned (max 4 cycles).

goal.description: The metric to move and the product context

data.description: Current metrics / experiment results to analyse (updated between scheduled runs)
data.default: No data yet — design experiments and state the data you need.

nodes.task:
Goal: {{input.goal}}

Propose the single highest-expected-value growth hypothesis to test next (ICE-scored, one sentence: 'We believe X will move Y by Z because W'). Build on learnings from earlier cycles; never repeat a killed idea.
Design the experiment for the hypothesis: variants, primary and guardrail metrics, sample size / duration for 95% confidence, and the decision rule set in advance.
Decide on this experiment line using the pre-registered decision rule.
nodes.verdict_guide: SCALE = a winner with sufficient evidence; roll it out. ITERATE = promising or inconclusive; run the next cycle with what was learned. KILL = evidence says this direction won't reach the goal.
